build_WindowMSA: build a window-based multi-head self-attention module with relative position bias for Swin Transformer
build_WindowMSAV2: build a Swin Transformer V2 window attention module using cosine attention and continuous relative position bias
build_ShiftWindowMSA: build a shift window multi-head self-attention module with cyclic shift and attention masking
build_MultiheadAttention: build a multi-head attention module with optional layer scale, value shortcut, and scaled dot product attention
build_CrossMultiheadAttention: build a cross-attention module that computes attention between separate query, key, and value tensors
